subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: While at least one await is registered, the wake channel shall check state on the adapter-advised cadence and, when an awaited transition is observed, deliver a wake naming only the await's identifier and the transition kind to the registered consumer.
fit_criterion: live drill on both media: a merge/accept is followed by a delivered wake within the M2 bound; the signal schema is closed (unknown fields = defect)
